work_item: Verify that ExplainPrevious Recovery fails closed when a saved AskPreviousRelation ResultRecord points to an actor-memory revision number with no retained snapshot
permission_scope: Continuing user authorization to implement in MINIDORA-BETA and retain work in its repository; local source test and focused checks, direct main commit/fast-forward push, and existing backup-reference rotation only.
other_writer_check: collaboration.list_agents returned only /root; the worktree was clean at batch start.

runtime.managed_cloud_environment: The existing /workspace/MINIDORA-BETA checkout was ready and clean at batch start. Pinned Rust/Cargo 1.99.1 were invoked using their explicit toolchain path and system compiler paths. Git CLI remote reads and ls-remote succeeded.
runtime.remote_access: Repository reads/writes use Git CLI; no GitHub connector API, deployment or external action was used.

implementation.change_type: One Engine-library clone-only regression test; no production logic, schema, dependency, manifest or lockfile change.
implementation.producer: A normal Japanese AskPreviousRelation ResultRecord records an existing actor_memory_revision and an exact sealed input after a premise and direct question are committed.
implementation.consumer: ExplainPrevious Recovery -> verify_previous_relation_context -> verify_saved_previous_relation_query_context -> result_memory_snapshot -> exact Store actor-memory revision lookup.
implementation.route: Commit premise, direct question, AskPreviousRelation and ExplainPrevious through Engine; reopen Engine and verify saved-state inspect; select and confirm an absent revision number; in a cloned CaseRevision only, rebind the saved prior result actor_memory_revision to that absent number.
implementation.expected_and_observed: The clone preserves result ID and exact sealed input ID/version/identity. Recovery stops with RECOVERY_CONTEXT_PROOF_CHANGED wrapping RECOVERY_MEMORY_REVISION_MISSING. Persisted case revision, current actor-memory head and target bytes remain unchanged.
implementation.compatibility: B91 tests a None actor_memory_revision; B92 tests a pointer to another retained snapshot with its premise invalidated; B93 covers Some(revision) with no retained snapshot.
implementation.compatibility_limit: The malformed CaseRevision is synthetic and never persisted. Persistent Store corruption, historical Rust schema records and migrations were not tested.
implementation.external_effects: None; the fixture uses temporary local state and a temporary permissioned output, cleaned by the test.

not_run: Actual historical Rust-schema ResultRecord/SQLite reads, persistent Store corruption/repair, schema migration.
